We adopt a set of automatic and human evaluation metrics to assess the model performances: Automatic Metrics. (1) We take the strategy prediction accuracy ACC. as an essential metric. (2) We then acquire the conventional PPL (perplexity), B-2 (BLEU-2), B-4 (BLEU-4), R-L (ROUGE-L) and M (Meteor) metrics to evaluate the lexical and semantic aspects of the generated responses. (3) For response diversity, we report D-1 (Distinct-1) and D-2 (Distinct-2) numbers, which assesses the ratios of the unique n-grams in the generated responses.
